caption: The drawing depicts a lantern with six vertical panels, five of which are visible, made out of a light-colored material. The lantern is shown in a three-quarters view, and it is rendered in shades of gray and black, indicating that it is a monochromatic drawing, likely made with graphite or ink on paper. At the top, the lantern features a loop handle composed of a circular ring supported by a cylindrical base decorated with perforated crosses and circles. Each panel frame converges at a slightly pointed arch at the top, with the upper sections of the lantern’s sides incorporating decorative lacy patterns of swirls and crosses. The door is visible at the front, differentiated by a small knob or latch. The lantern stands on small, pointed feet situated at the three visible lower corners. The background is plain and unmarked, emphasizing the central subject. There is a small signature or writing in the bottom right corner of the page.
